description: Despite oscillations and measurable local field potentials, the cerebellum is invisible in EEG and MEG recordings (Andersen et al. 2020, as reported by McFadden).
limitations: Reported secondhand in McFadden 2023. The reason for the invisibility is not known, by his account.

sources.quote: The key finding is the invisibility of the cerebellum in EEG or MEG measurements
